verdict.rationale: Kit's API overview says developers can manage their email list through tags. The Kit MCP exposes tags and segments with read and write access to live account data, and broadcasts can target segment or tag IDs. There is no specific evidence of create or update endpoints for tags or segments, or of an endpoint that lists exactly which subscribers belong to a tag or segment. Missing for 10: documented tag/segment create and update endpoints, programmatic segment definition, a membership read-back (list subscribers per tag or segment) endpoint, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them

citations.quote: manage your email list through tags and custom fields
exposes a creator's Kit account — subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments, and more — to MCP-compatible AI clients
the Kit MCP gives an AI client the ability to read and write live account data on the creator's behalf.
We currently support targeting your subscribers based on segment or tag ids.
